title: Être — present tense (set 8: comparisons — plus/moins/aussi...que, superlatives)

exercises.en: This exercise is more difficult than the last one.
exercises.fr: Cet exercice est plus difficile que le dernier.

exercises.en: Are you (informal) as tired as I am?
My brother is less patient than my sister.
exercises.fr: Mon frère est moins patient que ma sœur.

exercises.en: This neighborhood is the safest in the city.
exercises.fr: Ce quartier est le plus sûr de la ville.

exercises.en: Their solution is simpler than ours.
exercises.fr: Leur solution est plus simple que la nôtre.

exercises.en: We are just as determined as they are.
exercises.fr: Nous sommes tout aussi déterminés qu'eux.

exercises.en: This test is the hardest of the semester.
exercises.fr: Ce test est le plus difficile du semestre.

exercises.en: Is your apartment bigger than mine?
exercises.fr: Ton appartement est-il plus grand que le mien?

exercises.en: These shoes are less comfortable than the other ones.
exercises.fr: Ces chaussures sont moins confortables que les autres.
